derivation: Set q=A a(rho+p)theta/k^2 with an initially unknown convention factor A.
Differentiate q and use rho_prime=-3H(rho+p) plus p_prime=c_a^2 rho_prime, hence (rho+p)_prime=-3H(1+c_a^2)(rho+p).
Substitution of the CLASS/MB Euler equation gives q_prime+3Hq=A a[(rho+p)phi+delta_p-(rho+p)sigma].
Matching the already-frozen C10 coefficients of phi and delta_p fixes A=+1 exactly.
Matching anisotropic stress then gives -(rho+p)sigma=(2/3)L Pi=-(2/3)k^2 Pi, hence Pi=(3/2)(rho+p)sigma/k^2.

class_semantics.theta_reference: Ma-Bertschinger Eq.(22): (rho+p)theta=ik^j delta T^0_j; theta is velocity divergence

consistency_checks.momentum_dimension: q has the CLASS stress-density dimension multiplied by a/k^2, as required by delta J^i=a^-2 partial^i q
consistency_checks.anisotropic_dimension: Pi has stress-density dimension divided by k^2, consistent with Pi_,<ij> in the spatial stress tensor
consistency_checks.neutral_khronon: Because the production RTK patch adds khr_class_sources_newtonian(...).momentum_class to ppw->rho_plus_p_theta before metric evaluation, the same q_N map automatically retains neutral Khronon momentum.

k0_guard: Both q_N and Pi_N convention maps are finite-k scalar-potential maps and contain 1/k^2. Exact k=0 must not be reconstructed by division; it remains on the separately certified homogeneous bridge.
